dialogue.content:
The spec says the maximum firmware image size for the Meridian M4 is **480 KB**.

Source: EmberOS 3 Firmware Specification (FW-SPEC-003, rev 3.2), section 9.2, lines 97–103 — "The maximum image size for the M4 is 480 KB."

One caveat: this revision describes EmberOS 3.2.0, and the Project Heron brief notes that EmberOS 3.3 changes will be written into the next revision of the firmware spec. I didn't find any later revision or update that changes the 480 KB limit, but if you need the figure for 3.3 planning, it's worth confirming against the next spec revision.
